description: Hand-labelled questions over public AMD technical documents and a two-column arXiv paper. Downloaded on demand; see eval/retrieval/sources.json.

questions.question: According to the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, how many compute units in each CDNA 3 accelerator complex die (XCD) are disabled for yield management?

evidence.quote: there are only 38 CUs active, with 2 disabled for yield management

questions.question: In the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, how many operations per clock can a CDNA 3 compute unit's Matrix Core reach when exploiting sparse data?

evidence.quote: enables doubling the computational throughput up to an incredible 8K operations per clock for a CU

questions.question: What aggregate L2-to-XCD bandwidth is shown in the legend of the CDNA 3 memory architecture diagram (Figure 6) in the AMD CDNA 3 white paper?

evidence.quote: Green line is L2 to XCD 51.6 TB/s (Aggregate)

questions.question: Per the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, what is the maximum aggregate L2 read bandwidth across all eight L2 instances in the CDNA 3 architecture?

evidence.quote: the AMD CDNA 3 architecture has collectively up to eight instances and up to 34.4 TB/s aggregate read bandwidth

questions.question: According to the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, how much memory does each HBM3 stack hold on the Instinct MI300A APU?

evidence.quote: each stack contains 24GB on Instinct MI300X GPUs and 16GB on Instinct MI300A of memory

questions.question: What is the maximum number of GPU partitions supported by the AMD Instinct MI300A APU, according to the CDNA 3 white paper?

evidence.quote: the AMD Instinct MI300A APU has a maximum of three partitions with two XCDs per partition

questions.question: Per the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, at what maximum rate do the CDNA 3 inter-package communication links operate?

evidence.quote: the communication links have been systematically enhanced to operate at up to 32Gbps

questions.question: In the previous generation described in the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, what throughput did the two Infinity Fabric links between the AMD EPYC processor and the Instinct MI250X GPU provide?

evidence.quote: connected via two AMD Infinity Fabric links with 144GB/s throughput

questions.question: In Table 1 of the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, what is the Instinct MI250X GPU's peak Matrix FP64 throughput in TFLOP/s?
According to Table 2 of the AMD CDNA 3 white paper, how many total Zen 4 x86 cores does the AMD Instinct MI300A APU have?

evidence.quote: TOTAL “ZEN 4” X86 CORES 24 NA NA

questions.question: What transistor count does the AMD CDNA 3 white paper's specification table list for the Instinct MI300A APU?

evidence.quote: TRANSISTOR COUNT 146 Billion 153 Billion 153 Billion

questions.question: Which maximum power options does the AMD CDNA 3 white paper's specification table give for the Instinct MI300A APU?

evidence.quote: MAX POWER 550W or 760W 750W 1000W

questions.question: On which TSMC process node are the AMD CDNA 4 accelerator complex dies (XCDs) built?

evidence.quote: The AMD CDNA 4 XCDs are built on the latest process technology, TSMC’s N3P

questions.question: According to the AMD CDNA 4 white paper, how many compute units are active in each CDNA 4 XCD?

evidence.quote: Each XCD comprises 36 AMD CDNA 4 Compute Units organized as four arrays of 9 CUs, of which 32 are active

questions.question: What is the capacity of the Local Data Share (LDS) in the AMD CDNA 4 architecture?

evidence.quote: The LDS in the AMD CDNA 4 architecture is 160KB

questions.question: By what factor were transcendental rates increased in the AMD CDNA 4 compute unit to aid attention acceleration?

evidence.quote: the transcendental rates have been increased by 2x to aid with attention acceleration

questions.question: Per the AMD CDNA 4 white paper, roughly how much faster is the direct IOD-to-IOD connection than in the CDNA 3 architecture?

evidence.quote: The simpler direct connection between the IODs is roughly 14% faster than in the AMD CDNA 3 architecture

questions.question: How much memory does each HBM3E stack provide on the AMD Instinct MI350 Series (CDNA 4) GPUs?

evidence.quote: the memory capacity has increased to 36GB per stack for up to 288GB for a single processor

questions.question: What is the per-direction bandwidth of each Infinity Fabric link in the AMD CDNA 4 architecture?

evidence.quote: at 38.4Gbps for a total link bandwidth of 76.8GB/s in each direction

questions.question: According to the AMD CDNA 4 white paper's specification table, what is the peak engine clock of the AMD Instinct MI355X GPU?

evidence.quote: MAX ENGINE CLOCK (PEAK) 2,200 MHz 2,400 MHz

questions.question: How does the AMD CDNA 4 architecture support the TF32 numerical format that CDNA 3 handled in hardware?

evidence.quote: this has been moved out of hardware and is supported through software emulation utilizing the BF16 datatype

questions.question: Up to how many AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs fit in a 200kW direct liquid-cooled rack, per the CDNA 4 white paper conclusion?

evidence.quote: the AMD Instinct MI355X GPU is available in direct liquid-cooled form factors that can fit up to 128 GPUs in a 200kW rack

questions.question: According to the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet, how many SR-IOV partitions does the MI300X support?

evidence.quote: SR-IOV , up to 8 partitions

questions.question: What maximum total board power (TBP) does the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet specify?

evidence.quote: Full-chip ECC memory, page retirement, page avoidance 750W

questions.question: What peak engine clock is listed in the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet specifications?
How many JPEG/MJPEG codec cores does the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet list?

evidence.quote: 32 cores, 8 cores per group

questions.question: Per the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet, what peak AI/ML performance multiple does MI300X FP8 with sparsity offer over MI250X FP16?

evidence.quote: offering 13.7x the peak AI/ML workload performance using FP8 with sparsity

questions.question: What peak advantage on FP32 HPC workloads does the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet claim over the MI250X?

evidence.quote: a 3.4x peak advantage for HPC workloads on FP32 calculations

questions.question: According to the AMD Instinct MI300X data sheet, what bidirectional bandwidth directly connects each pair of MI300X GPUs?

evidence.quote: direct connectivity of 128 GB/s bidirectional bandwidth between each GPU

questions.question: On which baseboard is the eight-GPU AMD Instinct MI300X Platform interconnected, according to the MI300X data sheet?

evidence.quote: an AMD Universal Base Board (UBB 2.0) with industry-standard HGX host connectors

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 instruction set architecture guide, how many work-items make up a wavefront?

evidence.quote: A collection of 64 work-items that execute in parallel on a single CDNA processor.

questions.question: How many trap temporary SGPRs (TTMP registers) does the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA provide for the trap handler?

evidence.quote: 16 SGPRs available only to the Trap Handler for temporary storage.

questions.question: Per the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA guide, what is the maximum number of SGPRs that can be allocated to a wavefront?

evidence.quote: A wavefront can be allocated 16 to 102 SGPRs, in units of 16 GPRs (Dwords).

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA, in what block size is LDS space allocated to a work-group or wavefront?

evidence.quote: LDS space is allocated to a work-group or wavefront in contiguous blocks of 512 bytes on 512-byte alignment.

questions.question: According to the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA's small float data format table, what is the maximum value representable in the FP8 E4M3 format?
Which register bit must be set to 1 for BF8 and FP8 operations to produce correct results on AMD Instinct MI300, per the ISA guide?

evidence.quote: The register SH_MEM_CONFIG, bit[8] must be set to 1 to produce the correct results for BF8 and FP8 operations.

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA, how many clocks does the instruction s_sleep 2 wait?

evidence.quote: s_sleep 2       // Wait for 65-128 clocks.

questions.question: How many matrix multiplies does the AMD Instinct MI300 instruction V_MFMA_F64_4X4X4_4B_F64 perform?

evidence.quote: This instruction performs 4 matrix multiplies. Each operand contains 4 matrices back to back

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA, what offset value threshold selects the FFT mode of DS_SWIZZLE_B32?

evidence.quote: The FFT mode (offset >= 0xe000) swizzles the input based on offset[4:0] to support FFT calculation.

questions.question: For the AMD Instinct MI300 DS_BPERMUTE_B32 instruction, how is the per-lane address passed in derived from the source thread ID?

evidence.quote: Note the address passed in is the thread ID multiplied by 4.

questions.question: Although DS_GWS_INIT on AMD Instinct MI300 uses only 32 bits of its VGPR operand, how wide a read does the hardware treat it as?

evidence.quote: Only 32 bits are used but hardware treats this instruction as a 64 bit read.

questions.question: Which AMD Instinct MI300 MUBUF instruction writes back the L2 cache and returns an ACK to the shader?

evidence.quote: BUFFER_WBL2 40 Write back L2 cache. Returns ACK to shader.

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA microcode formats, what bit pattern must the ENCODING field [31:26] of the SMEM format contain?

evidence.quote: ENCODING [31:26] Must be: 110000

questions.question: In the AMD Instinct MI300 ISA FLAT microcode format, which SEG field value selects global memory instructions?

evidence.quote: SEG [15:14] Memory Segment (instruction type): 0 = flat, 1 = scratch, 2 = global.

questions.question: In 'Attention Is All You Need' Table 2, what EN-DE BLEU score does the Transformer base model achieve?

evidence.quote: Transformer (base model) 27.3 38.1

questions.question: In 'Attention Is All You Need' Table 2, what EN-FR BLEU score is reported for the ConvS2S Ensemble?

evidence.quote: ConvS2S Ensemble [9] 26.36 41.29

questions.question: How many parameters (in millions) does the 'big' Transformer configuration have in Table 3 of 'Attention Is All You Need'?
What WSJ Section 23 F1 score does the 4-layer Transformer achieve in the semi-supervised setting of 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: Transformer (4 layers) semi-supervised 92.7

questions.question: How many warmup steps were used in the learning rate schedule of 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: We used warmup_steps = 4000.

questions.question: For how many training steps were the Transformer base models trained in 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: We trained the base models for a total of 100,000 steps or 12 hours.

questions.question: What is the inner-layer dimensionality of the position-wise feed-forward network in 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: and the inner-layer has dimensionality df f = 2048.

questions.question: How many parallel attention heads does the base Transformer in 'Attention Is All You Need' employ?

evidence.quote: In this work we employ h = 8 parallel attention layers, or heads.

questions.question: What label smoothing value was used when training the Transformer in 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: During training, we employed label smoothing of value ϵls = 0.1

questions.question: What was the approximate size of the shared source-target byte-pair vocabulary for English-German in 'Attention Is All You Need'?

evidence.quote: which has a shared source- target vocabulary of about 37000 tokens

questions.question: Why did the authors of 'Attention Is All You Need' choose sinusoidal positional encodings over learned positional embeddings?
questions.answer: The two produced nearly identical results, and the sinusoidal version may let the model extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than those seen during training.

evidence.quote: We chose the sinusoidal version because it may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than the ones encountered during training.
